cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Whose objection would stop you paying the deposit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

mechanism: A withholds permission to proceed while probing which absent person truly controls cancellation and payment, maintaining superiority over the present partner.
confusable: Pretending to possess all authority would miss the Drive; A must actually seek the approval or veto chain while ruling on the immediate next step.
comparison: A trip deposit probes treasurer and deputy powers; the repair-money alternative traces signatures, finance and caretaker influence.
seedUse: Use D54-a committee approval and deputy login only as fictional scene facts, with S01 permission controlling booking pending real authority discovery.
